name: Better Auth
description: Turns your TypeScript app into an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP clients; listed for Better Auth's MCP OAuth-provider and CIMD plugins, for developers securing MCP servers.

skills.name: MCP OAuth Provider
skills.description: Runs your app as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server and protected resource that MCP clients discover and sign in to with PKCE.

skills.name: Protect MCP Routes
skills.description: Verifies MCP access tokens on your routes, checking signature, issuer, audience, expiry, scopes and DPoP binding before tools run.

skills.name: Client ID Metadata Documents
skills.description: Registers OAuth clients from HTTPS Client ID Metadata Documents, so MCP clients sign in without dynamic client registration.
